name: lesson-20
description: Bài 20 — thể thông thường khi nói chuyện thân mật: tra cứu, sửa chữa, kimono, visa và no bụng.

jobs.subject: the reference male student at a desk looking something up, running his finger down a page of a thick open reference book, a laptop open beside it

alt.vi: Chàng trai dò từng dòng trong cuốn sách dày để tra cứu.

jobs.subject: a mechanic in work overalls crouching beside an upturned bicycle, tightening the wheel with a wrench, a small toolbox on the ground

alt.vi: Người thợ dùng cờ lê sửa bánh xe đạp.

jobs.subject: a young woman standing gracefully in a traditional Japanese kimono with a soft floral pattern and a wide obi sash, full figure

alt.vi: Cô gái mặc kimono hoa văn và thắt obi.

jobs.subject: an open passport showing one inside page covered by a large blank visa sticker with a small portrait photo area and a plain decorative ink stamp, no text, letters or numbers anywhere

alt.vi: Cuốn hộ chiếu mở ra, trang trong có dán thị thực.

jobs.subject: the reference male student leaning back in his chair with a satisfied smile, patting his round full belly, chopsticks laid across a tall stack of empty plates and bowls in front of him

alt.vi: Chàng trai ngả người xoa bụng no bên chồng đĩa đã ăn hết.

jobs.subject: a relaxed afternoon in a small neighbourhood park; the male student and the woman sit side by side on a wooden bench chatting casually like close friends, each holding a canned drink; the male student points cheerfully down the path as if inviting her to go somewhere together, and she laughs and nods; trees, a low wall and a plain blank signboard in the background.

alt.vi: Hai bạn trẻ ngồi ghế đá công viên trò chuyện thân mật, chàng trai rủ cô gái đi chơi.
